BiblicalUsage: The creditor appears once, in the parable of the two debtors: a certain creditor had two debtors, one owing five hundred pence and the other fifty, and when they had nothing to pay he frankly forgave them both. The word survives in the manuscripts under the spelling with a single vowel, where the word lists give the fuller form.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the parable is the gospel in miniature: we are the debtors with nothing to pay, and the creditor is the God who forgives frankly.
